# 1 Samuel Chapter 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 156v–157r | **Source Image:** 1SA_013_page_001.jpg, 1SA_013_page_002.jpg

---

**13:1** Saul [was] a-son of-[...] year when-he-became-king, and-two years he-reigned over Israel.

**13:2** And-chose Saul for-himself three-thousand from-Israel: and-there-were with-Saul two-thousand in-Michmash and-in-[the]-hill-country of-Beth-el, and-a-thousand were with-Jonathan in-Gibeah of-Benjamin. And-the-rest of-the-people he-sent-away, each to-his-tent.

**13:3** And-struck Jonathan the-garrison of-[the]-Philistines which [was] in-Geba, and-heard [the]-Philistines. And-Saul blew the-trumpet [shofar] in-all the-land, saying, "Let-the-Hebrews hear."

**13:4** And-all Israel heard, saying, "Saul has-struck the-garrison of-[the]-Philistines, and-also Israel has-become-odious among-[the]-Philistines." And-the-people were-summoned after Saul to-Gilgal.

**13:5** And-[the]-Philistines assembled to-fight with-Israel: thirty thousand chariots and-six-thousand horsemen and-people as-the-sand which [is] on-[the]-shore of-the-sea in-multitude. And-they-came-up and-encamped in-Michmash, east of-Beth-aven.

**13:6** And-[the]-men of-Israel saw that [they were]-in-distress (for the-people were-hard-pressed), and-the-people hid-themselves in-caves and-in-thickets and-in-rocks and-in-tombs [tserichim] and-in-pits [borot].

**13:7** And-Hebrews crossed the-Jordan to-[the]-land of-Gad and-Gilead. And-Saul [was]-still in-Gilgal, and-all the-people trembled after-him.

**13:8** And-he-waited seven days, according-to-the-appointed-time which Samuel [had set]. But-Samuel did-not come to-Gilgal, and-the-people were-scattering from-upon-him.

**13:9** And-said Saul, "Bring-near to-me the-burnt-offering and-the-peace-offerings." And-he-offered-up the-burnt-offering.

**13:10** And-it-was as-he-finished offering-up the-burnt-offering, and-behold, Samuel came. And-went-out Saul to-meet-him to-bless-him.

**13:11** And-said Samuel, "What have-you-done?" And-said Saul, "For I-saw that the-people were-scattering from-upon-me, and-you did-not come within-[the]-appointed days, and-[the]-Philistines [were]-assembling at-Michmash.

**13:12** And-I-said, 'Now [the]-Philistines will-come-down upon-me to-Gilgal, and-the-face of-YHWH I-have-not-entreated.' And-I-forced-myself and-offered-up the-burnt-offering."

**13:13** And-said Samuel to Saul, "You-have-acted-foolishly [niskalta]. You-have-not kept the-commandment of-YHWH your-God which He-commanded you, for now YHWH would-have-established your-kingdom over-Israel forever.

**13:14** But-now your-kingdom shall-not stand. YHWH has-sought for-Himself a-man according-to-His-heart, and-YHWH has-appointed him [as]-leader [nagid] over His-people, for you-have-not kept that-which YHWH commanded-you."

**13:15** And-arose Samuel and-went-up from-Gilgal to-Gibeah of-Benjamin. And-Saul numbered the-people, the-[ones]-found with-him, about six-hundred men.

**13:16** And-Saul and-Jonathan his-son and-the-people, the-[ones]-found with-them, were-dwelling in-Geba of-Benjamin. And-[the]-Philistines encamped in-Michmash.

**13:17** And-went-out the-raider [ha-mashchit] from-[the]-camp of-[the]-Philistines [in]-three companies: the-one company turned to-[the]-way of-Ophrah, to-[the]-land of-Shual,

**13:18** and-the-one company turned [the]-way of-Beth-horon, and-the-one company turned [the]-way of-the-border that-overlooks the-valley of-Zeboim toward-the-wilderness.

**13:19** And-a-smith [charash] was-not-found in-all the-land of-Israel, for [the]-Philistines said, "Lest the-Hebrews make sword or-spear."

**13:20** And-went-down all Israel to-[the]-Philistines, each to-sharpen his-plowshare and-his-mattock and-his-axe and-his-sickle.

**13:21** And-the-price [ha-petsirah] was a-pim for-the-plowshares and-for-the-mattocks and-for-the-three-pronged-forks and-for-the-axes, and-to-set the-goads.

**13:22** And-it-was on-[the]-day of-battle, and-there-was-not-found sword or-spear in-[the]-hand of-all the-people who [were] with-Saul and-with-Jonathan; but-there-was-found for-Saul and-for-Jonathan his-son.

**13:23** And-went-out the-garrison of-[the]-Philistines to-[the]-pass of-Michmash.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **13:1 — Corrupted number**: The MT reads literally "Saul was a son of one year when he became king" — the age numeral has been lost in transmission. The LXX omits this verse entirely. EMET preserves the lacuna with [...].

2. **13:5 — "thirty thousand chariots"**: This number is textually suspect; many MSS and versions read 3,000. The Leningrad Codex reads שְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף (thirty thousand).

3. **13:14 — "a man according to His heart"** (אִישׁ כִּלְבָבוֹ): A proleptic reference to David. The phrase *ki-levavo* means "according to/after His own heart."

4. **13:19-22 — Philistine iron monopoly**: This passage is one of the most important archaeological footnotes in the Bible, documenting Philistine technological superiority in metalworking.

5. **13:21 — pim** (פִים): A unit of weight (about 2/3 shekel), confirmed by archaeological pim-weights found in Israelite contexts. The word was unknown until modern archaeology.

— EMET
